shared_elements: carved/worked stone surface in an outdoor, in-situ setting
shallow low-relief or pecked motifs on a coarse stone block
traces of curving animal-like or zoomorphic outlines
justification: Both are weathered stone blocks bearing shallow relief carving photographed in situ, and in each one can make out rounded discs and vague curving zoomorphic outlines, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. B is organised into crisp horizontal registers (an arcaded animal frieze, a woven/zigzag band, then discrete birds and quadrupeds), whereas A's surface is so eroded that no register system, figure repertoire or ordering is legible at all, so any resemblance is generic rather than compositional.
